name: darling-woo-tooling
description: Not a package - just the dependency list for scripts/. Every gate in scripts/ drives a real browser, so playwright is not optional; pixelmatch and pngjs are the pixel layer of scripts/dtest. This file exists because `npm i <something>` in a directory with no package.json creates one containing ONLY that something, and prunes everything else out of node_modules. That is how playwright vanished on 2026-08-10 and took eleven gates with it.
